config.how-is-my-wolf.title: How Is My Wolf Settings
config.how-is-my-wolf.linger.tooltip: How long the panel stays after you look away. 0 hides it immediately. The slider moves in steps of 0.05 s (one game tick).
config.how-is-my-wolf.panel_offset_x.too: How far to the right of the wolf the panel appears, in pixels.
